action.command: which ss netstat; for port in 34237 35581 38377; do hex=$(printf '%X' $port); found=$(grep -l ":$hex " /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null); echo "port $port: ${found:-NOT LISTENING}"; done; echo '=== children of urboards pnpm 92757 ==='; ps --ppid 92757 -o pid,etime,cmd 2>/dev/null; ps aux | grep -c 'defunct'
